scripts.verify: pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

//auditConfig: Reviewed audit exceptions. Each entry is a specific advisory, never a severity threshold or a
whole package, so a NEW advisory in the same dependency still fails the build.
All three live in the Prisma CLI, which is a devDependency of @kairos/database. They surface
under `pnpm audit --prod` only because @prisma/client declares `prisma` as an OPTIONAL PEER
dependency, so the resolver walks into the CLI's tree; nothing here is loaded at runtime.
prisma@7.10.0 is the newest stable 7.x, so no patched release exists on our pinned line.
GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx  deepmerge-ts  <- prisma > @prisma/config. Build-time config loading only.
GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr  mysql2        <- prisma. A MySQL driver. Kairos is PostgreSQL-only and the
GHSA-rgwj-5xj2-c3m3  mysql2           env schema rejects any non-PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL, so
Re-check when Prisma 8 reaches stable and at the Phase 15 security review. SECURITY_AGENT owns
this list; adding to it requires the same written justification.
